title: world protocol — identity components
description: What other systems and sources call an entity. This file exists because SPEC §2 gives the identifiers other systems and sources use a component of their own, and the reference crate has no module for them — a gap the sync test reports rather than papers over.

external_ids.title: external ids
external_ids.description: The identifiers other systems and sources know this entity by — a legacy system's, or a site template's key for what made it — carried as data: joinable, indexable, convertible, never identity, and never a reference target. This is how a conversion keeps a visible 1:1 with its source without reopening the string-identity door (SPEC §2).

additionalProperties.$comment: Property names are unconstrained: a naming system is whatever the other system is called, and a legacy name is not ours to spell. The values are constrained, because a value you cannot join on is not an external id.
additionalProperties.description: Whatever that system stores under that name — a number, a string, a flag. Never an object: an external id is a value to join on.
